definition.name: Claimant count, all sexes, age 16+
definition.population: All sexes, age 16 and over: Jobseeker’s Allowance claimants and relevant Universal Credit claimants under the publisher’s claimant-count eligibility and administrative definitions.
definition.period_convention: Publisher monthly reference-date stock, identified by YYYY-MM; not a monthly sum or mean.
definition.revision_policy: Previous months and longer histories can be revised. Retain the publisher revision metadata; current values are not a vintage archive.
definition.limitations: Administrative claimant stock, not ILO unemployment, a claimant rate or available recruits. Universal Credit eligibility, work-search conditions, rollout, classification and policy changes affect coverage and comparisons; arrangements can differ in Northern Ireland. JSA and relevant UC claimants are combined under the publisher definition; overlapping benefit populations must not be added again. Exact retained national months only; no local areas, seasonal adjustment, missing-to-zero conversion or older-release substitution.

definitions.name: Renewable generation as a proportion of gross final electricity consumption
definitions.population: Electricity generated and consumed in Northern Ireland, including metered and own-use generation; gross final consumption includes net imports and system losses.
definitions.adjustment: Physical electricity quantities; not seasonally adjusted
definitions.period_convention: Inclusive fixed rolling twelve-month window 2025-07-01/2026-06-30; month labels are not individual monthly observations
definitions.cadence: Fixed 3 September 2026 edition; future editions require review
definitions.publisher: Department for the Economy, Northern Ireland
definitions.methodology: Gross final electricity consumption includes metered and own-use renewable and non-renewable generation plus imports minus exports, gross of system losses; renewable numerator is indigenous renewable generation. Revised GFEC basis, not the superseded pre-2026 consumption measure.
definitions.revision_policy: Statistics in Development; rounded estimates and earlier periods may be revised, including own-use estimates and supplier corrections; not final.
definitions.limitations: Fixed edition published 3 September 2026 for July 2025 to June 2026; does not claim the newest available publication. Northern Ireland rolling twelve-month totals, not a calendar year, monthly average, UK or all-island figure. No historical series or fuel breakdown. Do not add consumption to its overlapping generation/net-import components. Renewable/GFEC share is not share of generation. Full methodology and revision status are anchored to retained same-edition evidence; a later article edition requires review.

Monthly statistics may be revised. England-and-Wales combined figures are not relabelled as either nation.
